content.tex: A INVESTIGATION (QUESTIONS 1 to 6)
TWO-STEP SEQUENCES (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This investigation looks at \(two-step\) sequences. These are sequences which use two steps to get from one term to the next.
The first term in every sequence is 1.
The two steps are: \(\bullet\) multiply by a given number \(\bullet\) then add a given number.

parts.text: In this question the two steps are: • multiply by 2 • then add 1. 1st term = 1 2nd term = 1st term × 2 + 1 = 1 × 2 + 1 = 3 3rd term = 2nd term × 2 + 1 = 3 × 2 + 1 = 7 4th term = 3rd term × 2 + 1 = 7 × 2 + 1 = 15

content.tex: In this question the two steps are: \(\bullet\) multiply by 2 \(\bullet\) then add 1.
1st term \(= 1\)
2nd term \(=\) 1st term \(\times 2 + 1 = 1 \times 2 + 1 = 3\)
3rd term \(=\) 2nd term \(\times 2 + 1 = 3 \times 2 + 1 = 7\)
4th term \(=\) 3rd term \(\times 2 + 1 = 7 \times 2 + 1 = 15\)
